thresholds.minFont12: smallest visible text >= 12px (display:none, visibility:hidden, <2px boxes and opacity 0 excluded)
thresholds.contentRatio88: content box of .page.layout / main.page >= 0.88 x innerWidth at >=1920
thresholds.contrastAA: every composited text/background pair >= 4.5 (>= 3.0 for >=24px or bold >=18.66px)
thresholds.controls40to44: button, text/date/number/search input, select, .search-box, .check between 40 and 44px tall
thresholds.gutters: padding-inline of the main .page equals clamp(16px, 3.5vw, 96px) +-0.5px
thresholds.footerText: footer textContent == 'Sudish Kumar · sudish.dev · GitHub repository · Evidence cutoff 20 Oct 2026 · Not legal advice'
thresholds.noStyleAttrs: querySelectorAll('[style]').length == 0 when readyState becomes interactive (before module scripts)
thresholds.noCspViolations: 0 securitypolicyviolation events during the page's checks
thresholds.wideMinWidth: computed min-width of every table.wide == data-cols x 13 x root font-size (+-0.5px)
thresholds.firstPaintLight: prefers-color-scheme: dark + empty storage: data-theme light at <body>, computed color-scheme light, background #ffffff
thresholds.themeCycle: t x3 then click x3: aria-label Light->Dark->System->Light, html[data-theme] and svg[data-mode] follow, visible .label at >=860
thresholds.keys: ] on s11 lands on s12.html, [ returns; / focuses #search; Esc leaves it
thresholds.print: emulate print at 1440: header and rails display none; every table.wide scrollWidth <= its .table-wrap clientWidth
thresholds.layoutColumns: section grid tracks: 3 at >=1440, 2 at 1024..1439, 1 below
thresholds.proseColour: OF-7: text nodes in .prose paragraphs/lists outside links, chips, kbd have the body colour, which equals the --fg token
thresholds.copyHidden: OF-10: every .anchor-h .copy has opacity 0 at rest
thresholds.heroHalves: OF-5: .hero-grid has two children with text; two columns (2 distinct left edges) at >=1440, stacked below
thresholds.legendOnce: D5/OF-5: 'Labels used throughout' occurs exactly once in the body text
thresholds.titleNoVerified: OF-4: document.title has no 'verified' (index, plan, feed, 404)
thresholds.best10Titles: DR-2: the ten .cards.best-10 h3 texts start with 'N. <title>' for the fixed DR-2 list
thresholds.best10Geometry: OF-8: .cards.best-10 columns (distinct left edges) 1 <720, 2 <1680, 3 <2240, 4 <2400, 5 at >=2400; exactly 2 rows at 2560
thresholds.cardsGeometry: D4: .cards columns 1/2/3/4 at <720/720/1680/2240 (sessions 7 cards; tracks min(3, cols))
thresholds.cutoffCount: D5: 'Evidence cutoff' exactly twice on index (hero + footer) and once outside the content elsewhere
thresholds.siteNameOnce: D1/D5: the site name occurs once outside the content (the .wordmark)
thresholds.overallWording: DR-9: progress line 'Overall N of M items (plan months are counted once a plan is chosen).'
thresholds.feedWidget: D6: #latest-feed lists real items or 'No feed items yet'; note 'Feed last updated <formatLastUpdated>. GitHub may delay or skip scheduled runs.'
thresholds.legendChips: D6: details.legend present with 5 chips in the summary and 5 definitions
thresholds.copyFocus: OF-10: the first .anchor-h .copy has opacity 0 at rest and 1 after focus()
thresholds.onPageCount: right-rail and inline 'On this page' link counts == .prose h3.anchor-h count
thresholds.scrollspy: after scrollIntoView of the third h3 (or the last when fewer), its rail link has aria-current=true within 500 ms and no other does
thresholds.prevNext: <link rel=prev|next> and the .prevnext links resolve (HEAD 200) and match
thresholds.linkParity: OF-7: .prose a[href^=http] count == markdown http link count of the section (verify.mjs --link-counts)
thresholds.codeCopy: Decision 11: every .prose pre has a client-added Copy button (40-44px); on s17 clicking it puts the block's text in the clipboard and the label reads Copied
thresholds.copyLink: clicking an .anchor-h .copy pill on s17 copies location without fragment + #id, sets the hash, and flashes 'Copied' then 'link'
thresholds.readingPosition: Decision 3: s06 scrollTo 1500, leave, return without a fragment -> scrollY within +-50px; with a fragment the heading wins
thresholds.search: / focuses #search (opens the box below 860px); 'quadrotor' -> >=1 group; ArrowDown/Up move focus; Esc closes and leaves; Enter opens the first hit on a page containing the term
thresholds.planStats: stat cards read 'Week 3 of 104 …', 'Month 1 W1–4 · 40 h planned (10 h plan)', 'Quarter 1 <§15.3 emphasis>', '20 h expected so far (2 completed weeks × 10 h)', '18 h logged · −2 h behind'; prompt card hidden; 10 h and B pressed
thresholds.planMonthCurrent: the 24-row month list marks month 1 aria-current=true; the 'This month' card shows month 1 (W1–4) with the plan-10h box
thresholds.planBudget: quarter budget table == the §15.3 Q1 row of the 10 h plan: F 50, P 10, B 35, E 8, W 12, C 5, R 10, Total 130 (labels from the §15.3 'Columns:' sentence)
thresholds.planGate: Gate Q1 (W13) foundations: 5 clause boxes s15:gates:q1:1..5 plus the one gate box s15:gates:q1 (Decision 7)
thresholds.planLog: hours log: the week input defaults to the current week (3); entries 'Week 1 10 h' and 'Week 2 8 h' listed
thresholds.trackGroup: OF-9/DR-4: the four .track-group buttons share one top at >=1024; exactly two distinct tops with two buttons each below 1024
thresholds.checkSize: OF-2: every visible label.check is 44x44 and its native checkbox 22x22 (plan, index, section pages)
thresholds.trackerRoundTrip: D6/OF-2: tick Rung 0 on s12 -> rail 'Rungs 1 of 9', tr[data-done], both inputs checked -> index rungs row '1 of 9', overall 1 of 122 -> 10 h plan + month 1 ticked: plan row '1 of 24', overall 2 of 146 -> back on s12 the box is still checked
thresholds.answersCount: Decision 21: with two non-empty plan.answers the s04 rail reads 'Answers (§4) 2 of 18' and the inline summary ' · Answers 2 of 18'
thresholds.planPrompt: empty storage at 1440: prompt card rendered, its quote == the §4 Q7 rule text of plan-data.json; stat grid and the empty left plan column not rendered (computed display); no month rows, no digits in the stat values; the §4 questions span the full grid width in two columns (9 rows for 18 questions)
thresholds.planExport: Export JSON downloads physical-ai-roadmap-export-<YYYY-MM-DD>.json with version 1, keys tracker/plan/triage and the fixture plan
thresholds.planImportInvalid: a version-2 file and a non-JSON file each show #plan-msg.error and leave localStorage byte-identical
thresholds.planImportMerge: a valid file after confirm(): imported entries overwrite (track C, rung 3 added), the rest stays (10 h, start date, rung 0)
thresholds.planReset: Reset after confirm(): tracker/plan/triage keys absent, theme key kept, prompt card visible again
thresholds.feedItemGeometry: OF-1: in every .feed-item no two child boxes (h3, .meta, .summary, .triage) intersect and the title's left edge equals the item's content edge
thresholds.feedActions: OF-11: the three triage buttons share one top at the title's top and sit right of the title at >=1440; three distinct tops right of the content at 820..1439; below the meta row under 820
thresholds.healthSummary: DR-9: details.health summary matches /^■ ok \d+ · □ empty \d+ · ✕ failed \d+ · \d+ sources · details$/ (a space after each glyph)
thresholds.unavailableRows: D6: every meta source with status failed renders a health row and a notices entry reading 'Unavailable since <date> · <error class>'; no other row does
thresholds.summaryEllipsis: DR-9: no .summary text ends with '...' or exceeds 300 characters
thresholds.protocolCard: DR-5/OF-6: table.protocol has exactly 3 tbody rows, every td text is a cell string of the §17.1 table (no added numbers), and the month-end line links s17.html#s17-1
thresholds.lastUpdated: D9: [data-last-updated] equals formatLastUpdated(meta.generatedAt) ('D MMM YYYY, HH:mm UTC') and the page says 'GitHub may delay or skip scheduled runs'
thresholds.feedFirstFive: D6: the first five items' title, source and date texts equal data/feed.json's five newest items (publishedAt desc, id)
thresholds.feedStatusLine: 'Showing N of N items in the window.' with N = feed.json items; triage counts 0 with a clean storage
thresholds.feedClassFilter: clicking Class 'Releases' shows exactly the release items of feed.json (ids and order) and the status line counts them; 'All' restores
thresholds.feedQueryFilter: clicking Query 'Aerial autonomy' shows exactly the items whose matchedQuery or alsoMatched carries the label; clicking it again clears the filter
thresholds.feedKeepPersists: Keep on the first item: aria-pressed true, chip 'Kept 1', physical-ai-roadmap.v1.triage[id].state == 'keep'; identical after a reload
thresholds.feedDropHides: Drop on the second item hides it (N-1 visible, 'Dropped 1') until the Dropped filter is active, where it is the only item, marked .dropped with Drop pressed; the generic checks (contrast AA) pass in that state in both themes; 'Everything' restores N-1
thresholds.feedLatestHome: index 'Latest from the feed' lists the 5 newest non-dropped feed.json titles in order and the note 'Feed last updated <formatLastUpdated>. GitHub may delay or skip scheduled runs.'
